name: Carlsbad Premium Outlets
description: Carlsbad Premium Outlets is a premier open-air outlet shopping destination featuring designer and name-brand stores offering savings of 25% to 65% every day. Located in North San Diego County, this Simon Premium Outlets property provides an upscale shopping experience with luxury and contemporary brands in a modern outdoor setting.
demographics: The center attracts affluent shoppers from San Diego County and Southern California, including families and professionals with household incomes exceeding $75,000. The primary trade area includes Carlsbad's upscale residential communities and nearby coastal cities, drawing visitors aged 25-65 who seek premium brands at outlet prices. Shoppers typically combine outlet shopping with leisure activities in the Carlsbad area, including beach visits and dining, with many traveling specifically for weekend shopping trips and tourist destination experiences.
